events.title: Ranger Ruben’s Raptor Program
events.partner_name: San Diego County Parks and Recreation
events.description:
Meet real birds of prey up close! Ranger Ruben brings live raptors to the library and shares what makes them incredible hunters, from sharp eyesight to powerful talons. A wild, unforgettable experience!

In partnership with County of San Diego Parks and Recreation and County of San Diego Libraries.

For more information, call (760) 742-1631.
events.location: Fallbrook County Library, 124 S Mission Rd, Fallbrook, CA 92028, USA

events.title: Discovery Table at Wilderness Gardens County Preserve
events.partner_name: San Diego County Parks and Recreation
events.description:
Celebrate 80 years of the County of San Diego’s Parks and Recreation Department at Wilderness Gardens! Join us for a Discovery Table and live animals such as: Rocco the Rosy Boa and Trent the Tarantula. Also, there is an opportunity for kids to participate in a visual scavenger hunt and identify plants and animals in the preserve.

For more info, call: (760) 742-1631
events.location: Wilderness Gardens County Preserve, 14209 CA-76, Pala, CA 92059, USA

events.title: Birding Hike at San Elijo with Women in the Wild
events.partner_name: San Diego County Parks and Recreation
events.description:
Join Women in the Wild for a scenic walk around the lagoon and learn about the many bird species that call San Elijo home. Bring binoculars!

Free event. Open to all ages. A limited number of binoculars will be available for use.

For more information, call (760) 634-3026.
events.location: San Elijo Lagoon Ecological Reserve, 2710 Manchester Ave, Cardiff, CA 92007, USA

events.title: Sturgeon Full Moon Hike
events.partner_name: San Diego County Parks and Recreation
events.description:
Experience the magic of the night as we take a leisurely evening stroll to discover the fascinating world of the prehistoric sturgeon. Along the way, we’ll meet the creatures who come alive after dusk—gliding bats, curious nocturnal mammals, and more.

Our journey will lead us up a gentle hill where a stunning moonlit view awaits. And to make the night even more special, enjoy theme-inspired snacks that add a fun and flavorful twist to the experience.

Come connect with nature, explore the mysteries of the night, and create memories under the glow of the moon. We can’t wait to walk with you!

Please RSVP at (619) 478-5212
events.location: Potrero County Park, 24800 Potrero Park Dr, Potrero, CA 91963, USA

events.title: Watershed Warriors: Park Cleanup at Sweetwater Lane County Park
events.partner_name: San Diego County Parks and Recreation
events.description:
Join I Love A Clean San Diego and the County of San Diego for a litter cleanup! We will divert litter from our watersheds and keep it from traveling to the Pacific Ocean.

Our staff will have check-in ready for you on-site. Be sure to wear comfortable clothes, closed-toed shoes, some form of sun protection (sunscreen or a hat), and bring a water bottle or two! Staff will be providing everything else you will need!

For more details: www.cleansd.org/events/watershed-warriors-spring-valley-sweetwater-lane-county-park/ https://www.cleansd.org/events/watershed-warriors-spring-valley-sweetwater-lane-county-park/ https://www.cleansd.org/events/watershed-warriors-spring-valley-sweetwater-lane-county-park/
events.location: Sweetwater Lane County Park,1312 Sweetwater Ln, Spring Valley, CA 91977, USA

events.title: Junior Ranger: The Amazing World of Water
events.partner_name: San Diego County Parks and Recreation
events.description:
Dive into an exciting Jr. Ranger adventure all about one of Earth’s most important resources—water! During this interactive program, young explorers will discover why water is essential for people, plants, and animals, and learn how we can protect our access to clean, safe drinking water.

Kids will:
• Learn why our bodies need water and how staying hydrated helps us stay healthy
• Explore how we keep water clean and safe to drink
• Investigate which plants and animals in the park depend on water to survive
• Help the ranger use water to support living organisms
• Play a fun water‑themed game
• Practice turning natural water into potable water through a hands‑on activity

All this learning and adventure leads to one big reward—earning a Jr. Ranger badge!

This event meets at the ranger station.

For more information, call (619) 478-5212.
events.location: Potrero County Park, 24800 Potrero Park Dr, Potrero, CA 91963, USA
